title: Detailed television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x='10' y='14' width='80' height='62' rx='6' fill='#8a6a3a'/>
  <rect x='13' y='17' width='74' height='56' rx='4' fill='#a8874e'/>
  <!-- Screen bezel -->
  <rect x='17' y='21' width='58' height='44' rx='3' fill='#3a3f6b'/>
  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x='20' y='24' width='52' height='38' rx='2' fill='#1f7a9c'/>
  <!-- Screen picture: sky band -->
  <rect x='20' y='24' width='52' height='16' fill='#2aa0c9'/>
  <!-- sun -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='32' r='5' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- hills -->
  <path d='M20 50 Q32 38 44 50 Q54 42 62 50 L72 50 L72 62 L20 62 Z' fill='#3ec97a'/>
  <!-- screen glare -->
  <path d='M22 26 L34 26 L22 40 Z' fill='#bff0ff' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- control panel -->
  <rect x='77' y='21' width='8' height='44' rx='2' fill='#7a5c30'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='28' r='2.4' fill='#e8e0c8'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='35' r='2.4' fill='#e8e0c8'/>
  <rect x='78.6' y='42' width='4.8' height='8' rx='1' fill='#d9cba6'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='56' r='2' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='20' y='76' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#6b4f28'/>
  <rect x='72' y='76' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#6b4f28'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='40' y1='14' x2='34' y2='6' stroke='#c8b98f' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='14' x2='66' y2='6' stroke='#c8b98f' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='6' r='2.4' fill='#ffd447'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='6' r='2.4' fill='#ffd447'/>
</svg>
